struct Matrix {

    vector<vector<ll>> a;
    Matrix(int sz = 0) : n(sz), a(sz, vector<ll>(sz, 0)) {}
    Matrix operator*(const Matrix& other) const {
        Matrix r(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                r.a[i][j] = 0;

                    r.a[i][j] = (r.a[i][j] + a[i][k] * other.a[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return r;
    }
    static Matrix identity(int sz) {
        Matrix m(sz);
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) m.a[i][i] = 1;
        return m;
    }
};

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    ll N, K;

    }
    vector<vector<Matrix>> pref(60, vector<Matrix>(k, Matrix(k + 1)));
    vector<vector<Matrix>> suf(60, vector<Matrix>(k, Matrix(k + 1)));

        suf[p - 1][k - 1] = base[p - 1][k - 1];
        for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; --j) {

        for (int j = 1; j < k; ++j) {
